title: Kerala Kitchen in Taunton Named Town's Best Place to Eat on Tripadvisor
excerpt: Mattancherry, a South Indian restaurant named after a Kochi neighbourhood, ranks first among 202 Taunton restaurants in the Tripadvisor Travellers' Choice Awards 2026.
body:
• Mattancherry, a South Indian restaurant in Taunton, Somerset, has been named the town's number one restaurant in the Tripadvisor Travellers' Choice Awards 2026, the Somerset County Gazette reports.
  • It ranks first out of 202 restaurants in Taunton on Tripadvisor, with a 4.8-star rating from 526 reviews, and is also rated the town's best Indian restaurant.
  • The kitchen serves Kerala food — dosas made fresh to order, curries and biryanis — at 10 Station Road, Taunton.
  • The restaurant is named after Mattancherry, the historic neighbourhood in Kochi, Kerala, and opened in 2022.

A taste of Kochi has beaten every other kitchen in Taunton. Mattancherry, a South Indian restaurant on Station Road, has been named the number one restaurant in the Somerset town in the Tripadvisor Travellers' Choice Awards 2026, according to the Somerset County Gazette — ranked first out of 202 restaurants in Taunton, with a 4.8-star rating from 526 reviews. It has also been named the best Indian restaurant in Taunton on the platform.

Kerala on the menu

Mattancherry serves food from Kerala: dosas — made fresh to order, and the dish the restaurant is known for — alongside curries and biryanis. The name is a nod home: Mattancherry is a neighbourhood in Kochi, Kerala, long shaped by spice traders. The Taunton restaurant, at 10 Station Road, opened in 2022. Its own site describes "a taste of South India" and lists sister locations in Bath, Bristol and Exeter.

"We are delighted to be named the number one restaurant in Taunton. It is a great honour for us and our team."

— Loganathan Ramasamy, head chef, Mattancherry

Manager Gopinath Dharmalingam told the Gazette the team was "very happy" and proud of the achievement. For readers in the UK, the restaurant's menus and locations are on the Mattancherry website.

Why it matters beyond Taunton

Regional Indian cooking — Kerala's dosas and seafood-leaning curries rather than a generic curry-house menu — keeps winning room in British towns well beyond the big diaspora hubs. A Travellers' Choice top ranking is a traveller-review honour rather than a critics' prize, but it is voted by the people who actually ate there: 526 of them, at 4.8 stars.
